name: Sheep's milk
definition: liquid milk of the sheep.

name: Evaporated and condensed milk
definition: milk with part of its water removed, unsweetened (evaporated) or sweetened (condensed), sold tinned or tubed.

name: Dulce de leche
definition: sweetened milk cooked down to a thick caramel-like milk spread.

name: Whipping cream
definition: cream of a fat content that whips.

name: Single cream
definition: pouring cream of lower fat content that does not whip.

name: Double cream
definition: cream of the highest pouring and whipping fat tier.

name: Thickened cream
definition: cream with a thickener added to a whipping fat tier so that it holds its shape when whipped.

name: Soured cream
definition: cream cultured to a sour, thick finish.

name: Goat's milk
definition: liquid milk of the goat.

name: Crème fraîche
definition: thick cultured cream with a mild sour taste.

name: Ghee
definition: clarified butter cooked until its milk solids brown, with a nutty flavour and long shelf life.

name: Spreadable butter blend
definition: spread of butter blended with vegetable oil; a spread that contains butter.

name: Butter
definition: churned milk fat and water, salted or unsalted.

name: Whole milk powder
definition: dried whole milk.

name: Kefir
definition: milk fermented with kefir culture (grains), a tart drinkable fermented milk.

name: Cheddar
definition: semi-hard pressed cheese made by cheddaring the curd, mild to vintage by age.

name: Gouda
definition: semi-hard pressed round cheese of Dutch type, young to aged.

name: Emmental
definition: semi-hard Alpine cooked-pressed cheese with large holes.

name: Quark
definition: fresh, soft, strained sour-milk cheese, spoonable.

name: Feta
definition: white cheese matured in brine, crumbly and salty.

name: Burrata
definition: stretched-curd pouch filled with strands of curd and cream.

name: Mozzarella
definition: stretched-curd cheese, moist and mild, fresh or low-moisture.

name: Brie
definition: large, flat white-mould soft cheese.

name: Camembert
definition: small, round white-mould soft cheese.

name: Limburger
definition: soft cheese with a washed rind and a strong smell.

name: Havarti
definition: semi-hard, smooth, buttery pressed cheese with small irregular holes.

name: Parmesan
definition: Hard, granular, long-aged cheese of the grana type.

name: Pecorino
definition: hard sheep's-milk cheese, salted and aged.

name: Gorgonzola
definition: blue-veined cheese of the Gorgonzola type, creamy to firm.

name: Cow's milk
definition: liquid milk of the cow, whatever its fat level or treatment, including lactose-free cow's milk.

name: Yoghurt
definition: milk fermented with yoghurt culture, set or stirred, plain or fruited, spoon-eaten.

name: Strained yoghurt
definition: yoghurt with whey strained off to a thick, concentrated texture.

name: Skyr
definition: strained cultured milk product of Nordic origin, sold as a yoghurt.

name: Cream cheese
definition: soft, spreadable fresh cheese of milk and cream.

name: Processed cheese
definition: cheese melted with emulsifiers and re-formed as slices, blocks or spread.

name: Spreadable soft cheese
definition: fresh soft cheese sold to spread, seasoned or plain, other than cream cheese.

name: Cheese selections
definition: selection of cheeses (for example a selection box) none of which is half or more of the weight.

name: Duck egg
definition: egg of the duck in the shell, raw.

name: Preserved or boiled egg
definition: egg of any species salted, pickled, cured (century) or plainly boiled in the shell.

name: Hen's egg
definition: egg of the domestic hen in the shell, raw.

name: Skimmed milk powder
definition: dried milk with the fat removed.

name: Infant formula
definition: breast-milk substitute for babies in the first months, a normal food (first or stage 1 formula).

name: Follow-on formula
definition: milk formula for babies from about six months.

name: Growing-up milk
definition: milk drink for toddlers and young children, outside the infant formula categories.

name: Almond drink
definition: drink made from almonds.

name: Coconut drink
definition: Coconut drink sold as a milk alternative; coconut milk and cream for cooking are in Pantry Staples.

name: Oat drink
definition: drink made from oats.

name: Soy drink
definition: drink made from soya beans.

name: Plant yoghurt
definition: fermented or cultured plant product sold as a yoghurt alternative, whatever its base.

name: Plant cheese, firm
definition: block, sliced or grated plant cheese alternative.

name: Plant cheese, soft
definition: spreadable, soft, camembert- or blue-style plant cheese alternative.

name: Plant cream
definition: plant product sold as a replacement for cream.

name: Plant creamer
definition: plant product sold as a replacement for cream or milk in coffee or tea.

name: Plant egg alternative
definition: plant product sold as a replacement for egg (for example aquafaba).

name: Cottage cheese
definition: fresh curd cheese in loose curds with a cream dressing.

name: Stilton
definition: blue-veined, crumbly, firm cheese of the Stilton type.

name: Jameed
definition: hard dried salted yoghurt of the Levant.

name: Kashk
definition: dried whey or strained yoghurt product of Iran and the Middle East.

name: Buffalo milk
definition: liquid milk of the buffalo.

name: Quail egg
definition: egg of the quail in the shell, raw.

name: Paneer
definition: fresh, unsalted, non-melting acid-set curd cheese of South Asia.

name: Buttermilk
definition: plain fermented or cultured liquid left from or made to resemble the churning of butter, sold as a drink or cooking liquid.

name: Drinking yoghurt
definition: Plain, unsweetened drinkable fermented milk, including ayran and plain lassi; sweetened or flavoured drinks are not part of this category.

name: Labneh and other thick fermented milk
definition: concentrated fermented milk that is neither strained yoghurt nor skyr (labneh, ymer, ylette).

name: Clarified butter
definition: butter with its water and milk solids removed.

name: Aaruul
definition: sun-dried hard curd of Mongolia.

name: Chhurpi
definition: hard dried cheese of the Himalaya.

name: Qurut
definition: dried salted yoghurt balls of Central Asia.

name: Kumys
definition: fermented mare's or other milk of the Central Asian type, defined by its culture.

name: Other blue cheese
definition: Blue-veined cheese sold simply as blue cheese or under a variety name such as Danish blue or Cambozola; Gorgonzola, Stilton and Roquefort have their own entries.

name: Roquefort
definition: blue-veined sheep's-milk cheese of the Roquefort type, cave-ripened, moist and crumbly.

name: Dairy creamer
definition: milk- or cream-based liquid or powder made to whiten coffee or tea, often sweetened or flavoured; plain cream goes by its fat tier.

name: Clotted cream
definition: cream heated and slowly cooled until a thick crusted layer of fat forms, spooned rather than poured, of the highest cream fat tier.

name: Aerosol whipped cream
definition: cream, usually sweetened and stabilised, packed under propellant gas in a can that whips it as it is dispensed.

name: Ricotta
definition: whey cheese made by reheating whey, often with milk added, and lifting the fine curd; soft, moist and mild.

name: Mascarpone
definition: soft, thick fresh cheese of cream set with acid, rich and mild.

name: Halloumi
definition: semi-hard cheese kept in brine whose curd is heated in whey and folded; firm, squeaky and non-melting when grilled.

name: Provolone
definition: stretched-curd cheese moulded in pear, sausage or cylinder shapes and aged, mild (dolce) to sharp (piccante).

name: Edam
definition: semi-hard pressed round cheese of Dutch type, mild, often sold in a wax coat.

name: Gruyère
definition: hard Alpine cooked-pressed cheese with a brushed or smear rind and few or no holes, nutty, aged for months.

name: Comté
definition: hard cooked-pressed cheese of the Jura type, made in large wheels from raw cow's milk and aged for months.

name: Manchego
definition: firm pressed cheese with a basket-weave rind, of sheep's milk in Spain (cow's or mixed milk in Mexican manchego), sold fresh to aged.

name: Soured milk
definition: Milk fermented whole at room temperature to a mild, thick or ropy drink or spoonable food, such as filmjölk, viili and piimä; not buttermilk.

name: Queso fresco
definition: fresh, unripened, salted white cheese of pressed or drained rennet or acid curd, crumbly or sliceable, mild (queso fresco, queso blanco, panela, Minas frescal, kesong puti).

name: Grilling cheese
definition: Fresh or briefly ripened cheese with a high melting point, sold to grill, fry or bake without melting and not kept in brine (queijo coalho, juustoleipä, kalari); halloumi has its own entry.

name: Brunost
definition: whey, often with milk or cream, boiled down until the sugars caramelise and set into a brown, sweet, fudge-like block (brunost, mysost, geitost, gjetost).

name: Brined white cheese
definition: white cheese ripened and kept in brine, soft to semi-hard, salty, sold as white cheese or under a regional name, not as feta (beyaz peynir, sirene, telemea, Domiati, Lighvan, Imeruli).

name: Sulguni
definition: elastic, layered stretched-curd cheese salted and kept in brine, sold fresh or smoked (sulguni, Megruli and Svanuri sulguni).

name: Kashkaval
definition: scalded, kneaded-curd cheese pressed in wheels or blocks and ripened, mild (fresh) to sharp (aged) (kaşar, kashkaval, caşcaval, kasseri, kačkavalj).

name: Braided string cheese
definition: stretched curd pulled into strands or a ribbon and braided, wound or coiled, peeled apart to eat, often brined or smoked (çeçil, chechil, Oaxaca, dil, örgü, korbáčik); stick-format mozzarella is mozzarella.

name: Other washed-rind cheese
definition: Soft or semi-soft cheese with a washed or smear rind, sold as washed-rind cheese or under a name with no entry of its own, such as Époisses, Munster, Taleggio, Reblochon or brick.

name: Raclette
definition: semi-hard pressed cheese with a washed or smear rind, made to melt and be scraped (Raclette du Valais AOP, Raclette de Savoie PGI).

name: Other tomme-type cheese
definition: Firm or semi-hard pressed cheese sold as tomme or under a maker's or regional name with no entry of its own, such as Tomme de Savoie, Cantal, Minas padrão or mantecoso.

name: Tulum
definition: crumbly salted cheese packed and ripened in an animal skin or a casing (tulum, guda, motal).

name: Roomi
definition: hard, sharp, aged cow's-milk cheese of the Egyptian type, often with peppercorns.

name: Cotija
definition: dry, salty, crumbly cow's-milk cheese of the Mexican type, sold young or aged for grating.

name: Rushan
definition: thin sheets of stretched cow's-milk curd wrapped on rods and air-dried to a shelf-stable fan.

name: Ryazhenka
definition: milk baked for hours until browned, then fermented to a thick, caramel-tasting drink or spoonable product (ryazhenka, varenets).

name: Liquid egg
definition: pasteurised egg out of the shell, whole, white or yolk, sold chilled or frozen in cartons.

name: Dried egg
definition: egg out of the shell dried to a powder, whole, white or yolk.

name: Walnut drink
definition: drink made from walnuts, sold as a plant milk or plant-protein drink.

name: Peanut drink
definition: drink made from peanuts, sold as a plant milk or plant-protein drink.

name: Other white-mould soft cheese
definition: White-mould soft cheese sold as soft-ripened cheese or under a name with no entry of its own, such as Chaource, Neufchâtel or Brillat-Savarin; not brie or camembert.

name: Crottin-type cheese
definition: small soft cheese of slow acid-set (lactic) curd, mostly goat's milk, ripened with a natural, geotrichum, mould or ash rind (crottin, Sainte-Maure, Valençay, Picodon, Saint-Marcellin).

name: Harzer cheese
definition: small cheese of ripened acid curd (quark), ripened with a smear or mould to a translucent, pungent body (Harzer, Handkäse, Olomoucké tvarůžky, Graukäse, gamalost).

name: Colby
definition: mild, moist, washed-curd semi-hard cheese of the American type, often orange.

name: Monterey Jack
definition: mild, pale, semi-soft to semi-hard pressed cheese of the Californian type, aged to dry Jack.

name: Fontina
definition: semi-hard, supple washed-rind cow's-milk cheese of the Aosta type, melting well (Fontina DOP; Danish and US fontina).

name: Asiago
definition: pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Asiago type, fresh (pressato) or aged (d'allevo).

name: Tilsit
definition: semi-hard smear-ripened cheese with small holes, of the Tilsit type.

name: Tomme
definition: Semi-hard pressed cheese of the Alpine or Pyrenean type, in small wheels with a natural grey rind, mild to earthy; fresh tomme curd is sold as Queso fresco.

name: Torta cheese
definition: sheep's-milk cheese set with thistle (Cynara) rennet and ripened under a firm natural rind until the paste is soft and spoonable (Serra da Estrela, La Serena, Azeitão, Torta del Casar).

name: Wensleydale
definition: Crumbly, moist, mild pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Wensleydale type; Wensleydale Blue is under Other blue cheese.

name: Caerphilly
definition: moist, crumbly, lightly pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Caerphilly type, young and mild or ripened with a soft rim.

name: Lancashire
definition: crumbly or creamy pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Lancashire type, made by mixing curds of more than one day.

name: Cheshire
definition: dense, crumbly, slightly salty pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Cheshire type, white or coloured red.

name: Gloucester
definition: smooth, firm pressed cow's-milk cheese of the Gloucester type, Double (full milk, often coloured) or Single (part-skimmed).

name: Spiced Dutch cheese
definition: Dutch-type pressed cheese of partly skimmed milk with cumin or cloves worked into the curd (Leidse kaas, Friese nagelkaas, komijnekaas).
